title: Services theme hero is the owner's window washer photo

source.ref: Owner, 2026-11-05: use this photo for the Services theme hero.

detail: The photo is optimized to WebP at public/sites/services/hero-squeegee.webp (1344x896, about 110 KB). The services-general kit hero ships it, so every new Services site and the theme page render fixture start on it. The baked theme-page pictures in public/brand/theme-pages/services were re-rendered with it (scripts/render/theme-pages-shots.render.tsx points at the photo).
